book.skysdomains.intro.body: Talismans with inscribed sigils open a Domain around you: a sphere in which every enemy is hit, no matter where it hides.
book.skysdomains.intro.body.2: This codex explains the path from the first ore to the Structural Collapse.
book.skysdomains.activate.body: Hold a talisman in your OFFHAND and press the activation key (default R, see Controls).
book.skysdomains.activate.body.2: Each domain costs energy, has a radius, a duration and a cooldown. The talisman tooltip shows the current values.
book.skysdomains.energy.body: The bar above your hotbar is your domain energy. It regenerates slowly; a talisman in the offhand speeds this up (more per tier).
book.skysdomains.energy.body.2: While your domain is open the bar shows the remaining time, afterwards the cooldown.
book.skysdomains.rules.body:
- Everyone inside the sphere is hit, no line of sight needed.

- You are immune to your own domain.
book.skysdomains.rules.body.2:
- Other players count as enemies; scoreboard teams are spared.

- Two overlapping domains clash: the higher tier wins, on a tie the one with more energy spent.
book.skysdomains.ores.body:
Arcane Ore: Overworld, Y -64 to 16, iron pickaxe. Drops Arcane Dust.

Abyssal Ore: Nether, Y 8 to 100, diamond pickaxe. Drops Abyssal Shards.
book.skysdomains.ores.body.2:
Void Ore: End outer islands, netherite pickaxe. Drops Void Crystals.

Fortune works, Silk Touch gives the block.
book.skysdomains.drops.body:
Wither: 85% chance of a Cursed Fragment (next to the Nether Star).

Warden: 90% chance of Echoed Matter.

Both are independent of Looting.

book.skysdomains.tiers.body: Each tier raises radius, duration and energy regeneration and lowers the cooldown.
book.skysdomains.tiers.body.2:
Upgrades happen in the smithing table: talisman + template + catalyst. Sigil and refinements are kept.

Templates are found in chests (next page).
book.skysdomains.templates.body:
Sealing Template: Nether fortress chests (35%).

Absolute Template: End city chests (30%).

Transcendent Template: Ancient city chests (25%).
book.skysdomains.catalysts.body:
Shapeless crafting:

Sealing Catalyst: 2 Abyssal Shards + 1 Cursed Fragment

Absolute Catalyst: 2 Void Crystals + 1 Nether Star
book.skysdomains.catalysts.body.2: Transcendent Catalyst: 2 Echoed Matter + 2 Void Crystals + 1 Cursed Fragment

T2 Sealed: Sealing Template + Fractured + Sealing Catalyst
book.skysdomains.upgrades.body.2:
T3 Absolute: Absolute Template + Sealed + Absolute Catalyst

T4 Transcendent: Transcendent Template + Absolute + Transcendent Catalyst
book.skysdomains.refine.body:
Anvil: talisman in the left slot, Refinement in the right slot.

Up to 3 per talisman, each +10% radius and duration. Costs a few levels. The tooltip shows the count.
book.skysdomains.d_frost.body: Enemies freeze fast and get Slowness; fully frozen they take frost damage every second. Water in the sphere turns to ice, lava to obsidian. You never freeze.
book.skysdomains.d_frost.body.2: The floor freezes over from the centre outwards into ice, packed ice and blue ice, and ice spikes shoot out of the ground like stalagmites. When the vault closes, everything thaws back to what it was.
book.skysdomains.d_umbral.body: Darkness for everyone but you. Enemies are pulled towards the centre and drown in shadows there: magic damage that ignores armour.
book.skysdomains.d_glass.body:
Pure defence: you get Resistance II and Regeneration II, enemies Weakness II. Hostile projectiles shatter on the sphere.

Lasts longer than the attack domains.
book.skysdomains.d_ember.body: The floor is infected from the centre outwards: it cracks, glows, turns to molten ground and lava pools. Enemies take fire damage every second, burn, and are scorched by every step on the ground.
book.skysdomains.d_ember.body.2: You are immune to fire and lava. When the garden closes, the ground heals back to what it was.
book.skysdomains.d_stasis.body:
Time stops for mobs: no movement, no AI, no attacks. Projectiles vanish. Players still move.

No damage of its own: strike the frozen enemies yourself.
book.skysdomains.d_collapse.body: Enemies freeze, the sky becomes space. A solar system forms, collapses into a white hole and hurls its planets at your enemies: 3 / 4 / 6 / 8 planets per tier.
book.skysdomains.d_collapse.body.2: Tier 4: the sun itself falls last and hits everyone still standing.
book.skysdomains.collapse_dmg.body: Each planet deals explosion damage (Mercury weak ... Jupiter strong, the sun strongest). Block damage is off by default.
book.skysdomains.collapse_dmg.body.2: Enemies stay frozen until they are hit or the domain ends.
book.skysdomains.config.body: config/skysdomains.json: energy, per-tier values, domain strengths, PvP and team rules, block damage, reduced flashes (accessibility), camera shake.
book.skysdomains.config.body.2: The activation key can be changed in the Controls menu.
